'''Naatu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] businessman of unknown species in operation during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
He was present for a business meeting held at the [[Star Cluster Casino]] on the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] moon of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3653 BBY]]. He and several other individuals were meeting to discuss their interests and how those interests would change now that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had forced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. As the meeting was called to order, Naatu was exposed as having provided information to the Republic and was summarily executed by [[Nok Drayen]], who then introduced [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Angral|Angral]] to the group to present the group with a proposition.
